headword: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}

definitions.gloss: driving under the influence of alcohol; DUI
definitions.explanation: Driving with a measured alcohol level at or above the legal limit (0.15 mg per liter of breath). It is one of the two legal categories of drink-driving ({飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}); the other, {酒酔|さけよ}い{運転|うんてん}, is judged by actual impairment and is the more serious.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{摘発|てきはつ}→摘発：12935_tekihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was caught driving under the influence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even drinking a small amount of alcohol can result in driving under the influence.

examples.japanese: {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{免許停止|めんきょていし}や⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧だ。
examples.english: Driving under the influence is a violation subject to license suspension and fines.

notes:
{酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん} is the drink-driving offense defined by a number: a breath alcohol level of 0.15 mg/L or more, with heavier penalties from 0.25 mg/L. The general word ⟦{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}→飲酒運転：18486_inshuunten⟧ covers it and the more serious {酒酔|さけよ}い⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧, which is judged by impairment (unable to drive normally) rather than by a fixed level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捕|つか}まる→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧: to be arrested for DUI
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧: suspicion of DUI
